title: Require backend model unused-field review
plan: Update the project backend-engineer agent instruction, preserving existing rules, to require an unused-field review for every backend implementation or modification.
Require repository-wide reference searches covering code, tests, migrations, serialization tags, JSON fixtures, and API consumers before classifying a model field as unused.
Require JSON/API contract and persistence checks, necessary regression tests, and an explicit breaking-change review; remove only fields confirmed unused and not contractually required.
scope: Agent instruction and workflow documentation only; do not modify production code, tests, or runtime configuration.
